question: What was the name of the official mascot for the 44th International Chess Olympiad, which was held in India in 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Thambi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thambi** was the official mascot for the **44th International Chess Olympiad** held in **India** in **2022**.
 
• The name "**Thambi**" translates to "**younger brother**" in **Tamil**, symbolizing the spirit of **hospitality** and **warmth** in Tamil Nadu, where the event was hosted.
 
• The mascot represents a knight in traditional **Tamil attire**, embodying the blend of **culture** and the **strategic essence** of chess.
 
• The event was a significant occasion as it was the first time that India hosted the prestigious **Chess Olympiad**.
 
• The **International Chess Olympiad** is a biennial chess tournament in which teams from all over the world compete.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chess Base**__

 __
 
• **Chess Base** is a popular **chess software company** that provides various products for **chess training** and **game analysis**.
 
• It is widely used by **chess players** and **coaches** to study and improve their game.
 
 
 
• **Bathusa Turtlestein**__
 __
 
• This option does not have any significant relevance to the **44th International Chess Olympiad** or chess in general.
 
 
 
• **Chess mate**__
 
 
• **Chess mate** refers to a position in the game of **chess** where a player's **king** is in check and there are no legal moves to escape checkmate.
 
• Although it is a chess term, it was not used as the mascot for the **44th International Chess Olympiad**.
